# `hyperstac-visualise`

Run HyPERSTAC clustering scans and create embedding, marker, spatial, and gallery reports

- Wrapper: [`job_hyperstac_visualise.sh`](https://github.com/dr-michael-haley/imcanalysis/blob/main/SLURM_scripts/job_hyperstac_visualise.sh)
- Conda environment: `hyperstac`
- Python module: `SpatialBiologyToolkit.scripts.hyperstac_visualise`

## Inputs

- HyPERSTAC representation/metric AnnData, patches, and optional permutation AnnData

## Outputs

- managed HyPERSTAC visualisation report and optional clustered representation AnnData update

## Configuration

- general, hyperstac, logging

## Run

From the dataset directory containing `config.yaml`:

```bash
pl hyperstac-visualise
```
